content: Entropy-based secret detection (Shannon entropy, used by gitleaks/trufflehog for git-history scanning) is noisy in general text: false-positives on UUIDs, hashes, base64 blobs, and example/test values; tools mitigate with per-rule entropy tuning or layered signals (regex + entropy + context + live validation). This is a scanning/discovery technique for unstructured corpora, not a fit for a deterministic per-line log redaction backstop, which needs zero false positives on the happy path.
